definitions.explanation: The physical quality of being heavy. The felt sense of heaviness in an object.
The quality of being important, serious, or carrying authority. Used for words, decisions, positions, and responsibilities.

examples.english: This stone has quite a bit of weight.

notes:
The nominal form of ⟦{重|おも}い→重い：00804_omoi⟧ (heavy), expressing heaviness as a quality or abstract concept.

SENSE 1 (physical):
Describes the felt heaviness of an object.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS (physical):
- {重|おも}み⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧ (to have weight)
- ずっしりとした{重|おも}み (solid weight)

SENSE 2 (figurative):
Describes the significance, authority, or gravity that something carries.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS (figurative):
- ⟦{言葉|ことば}→言葉：02880_kotoba⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{重|おも}み (the weight of words)
- ⟦{責任|せきにん}→責任：03298_sekinin⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{重|おも}み (the weight of responsibility)
- {重|おも}み⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{増|ま}す→増す：02422_masu⟧ (to gain significance)
- {重|おも}み⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧⟦{発言|はつげん}→発言：05099_hatsugen⟧ (a weighty statement)
